title: Unit – 1 : Session – 10 : SLO – 1  |  NOR gate and universal implementation
sections: 2. C — It can implement AND, OR, NOT gates
1. NOR gate — c) Output is 1 only when all inputs are 0
2. NOR as NOT — a) Connect both inputs together
3. NOR as OR — NOR the inputs, then invert the output with another NOR: ((A+B)')' = A + B
4. NOR as AND — e) De Morgan: invert each input first, (A' + B')' = A·B
5. Universal Gate — d) Any gate can be built using it
2. NOR as NOT: tie both inputs together → Y = (A+A)' = A̅. Truth table: 0→1, 1→0.
3. AND using only NOR gates: invert A (NOR with tied inputs) → A'; invert B → B'; then NOR the two results: (A' + B')' = A·B. Total 3 NOR gates.
